edit.description: Narrow acquireTipClaim's dead-pid reclaim unlink catch to ENOENT; rethrow other errors per engineering.md Loud or nothing.
Pin reclaim rethrow on a non-ENOENT unlink failure.

summary: acquireTipClaim's dead-pid reclaim swallows any unlink error, not just ENOENT, risking an unbounded tight retry loop on a persistent failure.
tests: a non-ENOENT unlink failure during reclaim rethrows rather than retrying forever
acceptance: Non-ENOENT unlink errors during tip-claim reclaim propagate; only ENOENT is swallowed to continue the retry.
notes: src/git.ts acquireTipClaim's for(;;) reclaim loop. Called from cli.ts:998 on every tick startup — a persistent unlink failure (e.g. EACCES) currently spins the loop with no bound/backoff instead of throwing. deleteBranch (same file) already discriminates its swallowed error by message; bring reclaim's unlink to the same discipline.
